conventions.convention: M is a smooth Hausdorff second-countable boundaryless four-manifold; g has signature (−,+,+,+), N is a smooth timelike time-orientation field, and the manifold orientation o is independent of g and N. F is an arbitrary smooth real two-form, without a Maxwell equation or potential assumption.

Observers satisfy g(n,n)=−1 and g(n,N)<0. Observer congruences, adapted coordinate charts and tetrad fields are distinct objects; adapted tetrads exist locally, without global tetrad or hypersurface-orthogonality assumptions.
The Hodge operator is characterized by α∧★β=⟨α,β⟩g vol_g, with normalized exterior pairing (1/k!)α_a₁…aₖβ^a₁…aₖ. Its square is (−1)^(k(4−k)+1), including ★²=−id on two-forms.
Conformal factors Ω are smooth, positive and dimensionless; the rescaled metric Ω²g retains the same manifold orientation.

E_a=cF_ab n^b and B_a=−(★F)_ab n^b, with c>0. In a positively oriented observer-adapted tetrad, F_0i=−E_i/c and F_ij=ε_ijk B_k with ε_123=+1. Arbitrary mathematical F carries no assigned physical measurement or field unit.

Length-coordinate bookkeeping assigns metres to all x^a, writes x^0=ct, and records dimensionless metric components, connection components in m⁻¹ and curvature components in m⁻². The inherited tangent-bundle background assumes Countable Choice, without an additional full Choice assumption.

load_bearing.statement: Defines the smooth oriented, time-oriented Lorentzian four-manifold, arbitrary smooth real two-form, observer, congruence, chart, tetrad, worldline and length-coordinate conventions; proves local observer-adapted tetrad existence.

For 0≤k≤4, the unique smooth Hodge map characterized by α∧★gβ=⟨α,β⟩g vol_g satisfies ★g²=(−1)^(k(4−k)+1)id. For two-forms, (★gF)_ab=(1/2)(vol_g)_abcd F^cd. Exterior differentiation satisfies d²=0 and the graded product rule.
For smooth positive dimensionless Ω and g̃=Ω²g with the same orientation, ★g̃β=Ω^(4−2k)★gβ for every smooth k-form β, 0≤k≤4.
For a smooth observer congruence n and smooth real two-form F, E_a=cF_ab n^b and B_a=−(★gF)_ab n^b annihilate n; F=n♭∧E/c+★g(n♭∧B), F_abF^ab=2(⟨B,B⟩n−⟨E,E⟩n/c²), and F∧F=−(2/c)⟨E,B⟩n vol_g.

seams_checked.note: Checked the consumer page and its direct supplier uses against the supplied definitions and statements. The scaling dictionary preserves the geometry and length-coordinate conventions. The conformal Maxwell theorem uses the exact all-degree multiplier, restricts to positive smooth Ω with unchanged orientation, and proves both directions with current scaling Ω⁻⁴. The conformal Einstein calculation cites the established exterior-calculus identities without claiming curvature invariance. The residual proposition uses real linearity on a fixed smooth metric. No reverse dependency or stronger supplier claim was found. Tong's cited equations (2.87) and (3.97)–(3.98) were also opened to check the component and Lorentzian square conventions.
